channels_note: Mention it from the feed you already post on. Same bot, same catalog, same answer — the channel only changes where the reply lands.
chains_note: Name a chain in the mention and the launch is routed there. If a route cannot complete, it says so before a single lamport is spent.

roadmap.title: A mention becomes a token
items: Live on Solana mainnet — coins created, confirmed on chain, tradeable
Your token trades against a tokenized stock, not against SOL
80/20 creator split written into the launch transaction, not promised for later
Around a dollar per launch, measured — not estimated

roadmap.title: Ask however you talk
items: The model reads the request, the code approves it — Portuguese, English, typos and all
Got the ticker wrong? It shows you what it thinks you meant and waits for a yes
842 tokenized assets tracked, the deep ones offered as pairs, the thin ones explained
Live on Discord, Telegram and X — one mention, wherever you already are

roadmap.title: Pick your chain
items: Solana through pump.fun and StonkFun, Robinhood Chain through Pons, BNB through four.meme
Name the chain in the mention and the route follows — no dashboard, no second step
Say nothing and it picks the route that can actually deliver right now
A route that cannot complete is refused out loud, before any spend

roadmap.title: Get paid for it
items: Bind a wallet to your handle once — every coin you launch pays into it
Claim your creator share straight from the mention that made the coin
Fees settling to both sides of the pair, proven end to end on mainnet
